title: Melon Sandbox
sourceDescription: Experiment with weapons, vehicles, and items in this creative ragdoll sandbox. Play this game online for free on desktop, iOS, and Android devices.
description: Melon Sandbox is an open-ended creative sandbox where imagination drives everything. From the moment the game loads, a wide selection of items is available: melee weapons, guns, barrels, armored vehicles, magical syringes, characters, accessories, background textures, and a large number of user mods and objects — including styles inspired by well-known games, movies, and memes. The goal is to build any scene, fill it with objects and characters, and then test it using weapons, vehicles, explosions, and other tools, observing the resulting effects and destruction. There is no formal level system and no enemies at the start. Difficulty is entirely self-directed — the sandbox provides an endless field of possibilities for self-expression and creativity. Creations can be saved and shared with the community, and mods uploaded by other players may be brought into your own world to diversify it further.

title: MR RACER - Car Racing
sourceDescription: Drive supercars through traffic in MR RACER - Car Racing. Complete missions and customize your ride in this free online game for desktop, iOS, and Android devices.
description: MR RACER - Car Racing, developed by ChennaiGames, drops you behind the wheel of blazing-fast supercars on chaotic streets packed with traffic. Race through 5 realistic locations — Farmland, City, Mountain Day, Mountain Night, and Snow — across 6 distinct game modes, all backed by stunning 3D graphics and realistic lighting. Multiple camera angles (first-person, third-person, and top-down) let you find the view that suits your style, while Maria cheers you on throughout. Hit the streets at high speed, weave through an engaging and intelligent traffic system, and push your reflexes across over 100 missions. Choose from automatic or manual acceleration, then pick a mode that matches what you're after — pile through 100 Challenge Mode levels, chase opponents across unlimited Chase Mode stages, or grind through Career Race Mode to beat rivals and reach legend status. Endless, Time Trial, and Free Ride round out the six available modes. Between races, upgrade your cars to boost performance and customize them with paint jobs and wheels from the full roster of 15 supercars.

title: Piece of Cake: Merge & Bake
sourceDescription: Restore your grandfather's café in this merge puzzle game. Combine ingredients, unlock dishes, and renovate 21 locations. Playable online and free on mobile or desktop.
description: Piece of Cake: Merge & Bake is a cozy puzzle and café management game from HAPPY GAMES STUDIO where you return to your grandfather's abandoned countryside café and restore it to its former glory. Combine ingredients on a merge board, cook dishes for visitors, and breathe new life into a once-popular spot — all while uncovering family secrets and meeting new characters along the way. Twenty-one distinct locations await restoration, each with its own style and theme. The goal is to revive the café by cooking food and drinks, earning money to repair and upgrade each location one by one. Combine matching ingredients on the cooking table to produce increasingly complex dishes, and expand your table territory to hold more ingredients at once. Each amount earned goes toward restoring the café and unlocking new areas, so progress is visible at every stage. Hints guide you through early missions, and the game shows you what to do from the very first steps.

title: TB World
sourceDescription: Explore your creativity in TB World. Design unique looks and decorate cozy interiors in this free online game available on desktop, iOS, and Android devices.
description: TB World is a creative sandbox experience built around one idea: bringing your own stories and looks to life. The game invites players to design one-of-a-kind character outfits and cozy interiors, with imagination as the only real boundary. One scene shows a world map dotted with illustrated buildings — a pool house, a residential home with a cat-shaped roof, and a multi-story apartment complex. Another moment places a bunk bed against a blue wall beside a three-tier metal shelving unit, hinting at the kind of lived-in spaces waiting to be arranged. The interface is described as intuitive and user-friendly, making it accessible to players of all ages.

title: Arrow Puzzle
sourceDescription: Clear the grid by removing arrows in the correct order in this logic puzzle. Play this game for free online on your desktop, Android, or iOS device.
description: Arrow Puzzle is a relaxing logic puzzle game built around clear rules and satisfying step-by-step thinking. The goal is to remove every arrow from a maze-like grid in the correct order, opening free paths as each move creates space for the next. Calm visuals, rewarding progression, daily challenges, and helpful hints make it a strong pick for logic challenges and casual brain training gameplay. Clear the grid by removing all arrows from the board. Tap an arrow only when the path in front of it is unobstructed — a successful tap removes that arrow and opens space for others. Tapping a blocked arrow costs a life, so planning the right sequence is essential. Think a few moves ahead, use hints when needed, and clear the full board to complete each level.

title: PVZ Fusion Cheats
sourceDescription: Defend your garden from zombie waves by creating unique plant hybrids. This tower defense game is free to play online on desktop and mobile devices.
description: PVZ Fusion Cheats brings a fresh take on the Plants vs. Zombies formula, keeping the classic tower defense roots while introducing hybrid plants that merge the powers of two or more ordinary plants. Set during a zombie apocalypse where hordes are trying to break into your home, the game adds smarter, more cunning zombies alongside a cheat feature that removes all resource limits — grab as many sun points as you want and place as many plants as you can handle. Place hybrid plants and regular plants on the field to hold back waves of zombies. Each plant has a cost and a recharge time, so keep both in mind when building your defenses. As the zombies grow tougher and more cunning across levels, swap out tactics, mix plant combinations, and develop new strategies to protect your garden. A brief tutorial at the start covers the basics without overloading you, then immediately drops you into a level to test your knowledge in practice. Difficulty can be adjusted based on your readiness.

title: Mahjong Classic
sourceDescription: Enjoy Mahjong Classic online for free. This solitaire game features unique level generation and popular layouts like Turtle and Dragon. Play on desktop, iOS, or Android.
description: Clear the board. That's it. Match pairs of identical tiles to remove them. Free tiles only. If both sides are open, it's fair game. No moves left? You lose. Simple math. Pure strategy. Perfect for puzzle fans. Great for brain training sessions. Ideal for mahjong purists who want traditional rules with modern convenience. Works for quick 5-minute plays or long strategy marathons.

title: Hazmob FPS: Online Shooter
sourceDescription: Experience intense multiplayer combat in Hazmob FPS: Online Shooter. Engage in various game modes on your desktop. This first-person shooter is playable online and free.
description: Hazmob FPS: Online Shooter is a multiplayer first-person shooter where every second of hesitation costs you. Developed by Hazmob, it drops you into non-stop combat against real players across nine distinct game modes — from classic team battles to tactical bomb scenarios — all built around pure reflex and skill. Clean 3D graphics and a fluid control system keep movement quick and precise, while four maps designed for close-quarters engagements push every match toward fast-paced, high-pressure action. Pick a game mode and dive straight into battle — onboarding happens inside the first match itself. Maps are built for close-quarters combat, so positioning and quick decision-making matter as much as aim. Complete missions, earn experience points and ranks, and unlock new weapons and gear as your level climbs. Upgrade your fighter's equipment to affect resistance to shots, agility, speed, and maneuverability. Organize team competitions through the Friends system, or join a clan for larger-scale play. Use sound to orient yourself quickly — it indicates where fights are happening so you can react faster to opponents.

title: Hedgies
sourceDescription: Transform an abandoned plot into a thriving farm in this casual building game. Play this farming adventure online for free on desktop, iOS, and Android devices.
description: Hedgies, developed by RedSpell, drops you into a desolate, abandoned plot of land and hands the keys to a single hardworking hedgehog with a surprising range of talents — cooking, fishing, crafting, and a genuinely hospitable streak. The goal: transform that neglected homestead into a bustling, flourishing farm and bring life back to the Valley. Take charge of your hedgehog and get to work turning an abandoned plot into a thriving homestead. Grow crops, craft goods, and sharpen skills across cooking and fishing as you build up the valley into a lively community.

title: Good Sort Master: Triple Match
sourceDescription: Organize items on shelves by matching three identical objects to clear levels. This relaxing game is free to play online on desktop, iOS, and Android devices.
description: You start with a wooden shelf grid packed with random groceries. Scan for duplicates—say, three tomatoes scattered across different slots. Drag one tomato to a compartment. Then drag the other two into the same space. Boom. They vanish. The shelf breathes. The real puzzle kicks in when shelves are dense. You might see milk cartons blocking cheese wedges. Move the milk first to free up the cheese. But wait—if you stack milk carelessly, you'll trap juice boxes. Every drag matters. Every choice creates ripples. It's a zen game of spatial foresight.

title: Nuts Puzzle: Sort By Color
sourceDescription: Sort colored nuts onto matching bolts in this brain-training puzzle game. Restore your garden as you play online for free on desktop, iOS, and Android devices.
description: Nuts Puzzle: Sort by Color is a classic puzzle game where the goal is to sort color-coded nuts onto matching bolts until every screw holds nuts of a single color. The challenge builds steadily as levels introduce more nuts and a wider range of colors, demanding careful planning and thinking several steps ahead. Beyond the sorting itself, a progression system lets players gradually repair their garden by spending the in-game Nuts currency on fixing flowers, giving each solved puzzle a tangible reward beyond the level itself. The visuals are described as beautiful and vibrant, and the game is designed to deliver a satisfying sense of accomplishment with each successful sort.

title: Sandbox City
sourceDescription: Explore a city, drive vehicles, and fight off zombie infections in this browser game. Play Sandbox City online for free on desktop, iOS, and Android devices.
description: Sandbox City - Cars, Zombies, Ragdolls! drops you into a bustling metropolis where ordinary citizens share the streets with zombies that can attack people or blend in as regular passersby. The goal is to find and eliminate the infected before the zombie outbreak spreads and consumes the city. Along the way, your character buys a house, steals cars, completes missions to save residents, and takes on the chaos with an arsenal of weapons ranging from baseball bats to sniper rifles.

title: Snake 2048
sourceDescription: Grow your snake by eating smaller cubes and dodging larger opponents. This game is free to play online on desktop, Android, and iOS devices.
description: Snake 2048 is an arena-based snake game where you start as a small cube and grow by eating smaller cubes and opponents — all while dodging snakes with more mass than you. Every player leaves a trail of small cubes behind them: consume those first to build size, then take on opponents directly. Attacks don't have to be head-on — you can chip away at opponents in parts. Your tail, however, is just as vulnerable to rivals as theirs is to you.

title: Master Chess
sourceDescription: Sharpen your tactics in this classic chess game. Compete online for free against AI or players worldwide on your desktop, iOS, or Android mobile device.
description: Master Chess brings the timeless battle of wits to your browser, challenging you to sharpen your tactics and defeat the king. The game pits you against either an AI opponent or players from around the world in online competition. Several scenes show a square wood-textured grid of alternating light tan and dark brown squares. Bright blue squares with thick borders appear over specific board locations across multiple views of the game.

title: Geometry Arrow 2
sourceDescription: Navigate through 13 challenging cave levels in this skill game. Customize your character and dodge obstacles. Play this game online for free on desktop and mobile.
description: Geometry Arrow 2 is the sequel to the original game about an arrow navigating a cave. The goal remains the same at its core: reach the portal at the end of the cave without getting hit. Along the way, unique obstacles stand between the player and that exit. Massive geometric structures made of white squares and triangles form the obstacles against a black void, and several scenes show a small circular object with internal wheel-like spokes and a glowing trail resting on a platform. Glowing circular rings and orbs appear within the central path of the level structures across multiple views.

title: Moto X3M
sourceDescription: Master off-road circuits and perform stunts in Moto X3M. This bike racing game is playable online for free on desktop, iOS, and Android devices. Beat the clock.
description: Moto X3M is a challenging off-road bike game built around physics-based racing across tons of obstacle-filled circuits. Choose a bike, put your helmet on, and push through level after level of complex terrain — from sunny beaches to underground caves — where precision, balance, and aerial tricks all factor into your final time. Earn up to three stars per level, and spend those stars to purchase new motorcycles. The goal is to survive every trap on a course and reach the finish. Speed matters — the faster you complete a level, the more stars you earn, up to a maximum of three. Those stars go toward purchasing new motorcycles. As you advance, routes grow increasingly complex, introducing new traps and dynamic landscape elements.

title: Basketball Stars
sourceDescription: Compete in 1-on-1 or 2-player basketball matches with famous athletes. Perform dunks and supershots in this free online game for desktop, iOS, and Android.
description: Basketball Stars is a 2-player basketball game by MadPuffers, prepared for the 2025 basketball season. Pick your team, step onto the court, and rack up dunks and 3-pointers to outsccore your opponent. Blocking and slapping are fair play — knock the ball loose and take control. Keep an eye on the supershot bar at the top of the screen; once it's full, unleash the special dunk from anywhere on the court for a guaranteed score.

title: Fruit Merge: Juicy Drop Game
sourceDescription: Combine identical fruits to create larger varieties in this matching puzzle. Play this game for free online on desktop, Android, and iOS devices.
description: Fruit Merge: Juicy Drop Game drops colorful fruits into a container and challenges you to merge identical ones into ever-larger varieties — all the way up to a gigantic final fruit that only 1% of players have ever created. The goal is deceptively simple: pair matching fruits before the container overflows. Several scenes show a transparent rectangular container holding various colorful round objects with expressive faces. A green character with cat ears and watermelon skin patterns appears next to the container in multiple views of the game.

title: My Perfect Farm: Idle Tycoon
sourceDescription: Manage your farm, grow crops, and care for animals in this idle simulator. Play this relaxing game online for free on your desktop or android device.
description: My Perfect Farm: Idle Tycoon puts you in charge of turning green fields into a bustling farm city. Starting from open land, you plant and harvest crops, care for animals, hire helpers, and steadily grow a full farm business. The game pitches itself as a warm, soothing escape from everyday hustle — a cozy farming simulator where the pace is yours to set. Several scenes show clean 3D graphics across the farm's various areas. The overall look keeps things bright and approachable, matching the relaxed tone the game aims for.

title: Stickman Kombat 2D
sourceDescription: Engage in intense stickman combat with precise combos and aerial strikes. This fighting game is playable online for free on desktop, Android, and iOS devices.
description: Stickman Kombat 2D drops you into a world of fast-paced combat, precise combos, and intense stickman fights. Victory depends primarily on the speed of your strikes — choose a fighter from the roster, enter the arena, and face a succession of increasingly powerful opponents with no second to spare. The game captures the atmosphere of legendary fighting games in a lighter, faster form, with intuitive controls and clean graphics that pull you in from the very first seconds. The backgrounds are alive with small stories unfolding behind the fighters: in one scene, sharp blue ice spikes line the arena floor, while another shows dark red curtains and tall stone columns framing a purple-toned room. A green character sits in a gold cage suspended from the ceiling in several scenes. Someone rides a train; someone cooks food over a fire in an icy cave — the world keeps moving while the battle unfolds, giving the fights the feel of heroic action.
